scenarios.title: Basmati stored dry, held Nov-Feb
scenarios.note: Starts dry (a_w 0.60); winter air is humid (IMD 08:30 RH 84-93 %)

scenarios.title: Basmati held into the monsoon
scenarios.note: Held through Jun-Sep; jute bag absorbs monsoon humidity

scenarios.title: Monsoon hold with outages
scenarios.note: Wi-Fi off 30 h (buffer overflows), power cut 6 h, Wi-Fi off 2 h

scenarios.title: Probe hung in shed air
scenarios.note: Same lot, probe outside the grain

assumptions.climate: IMD, Climatological Tables of Observatories in India 1991-2020, 9th ed. (2022), station Patiala 42101, p. 300; https://imdpune.gov.in/library/public/Climatological%20Tables%201991-2020.pdf, read 22 Oct 2026
assumptions.shed_rh: sinusoid in phase with temperature fitted through the IMD 08:30 and 17:30 IST monthly means, clipped to 5-98 %; shed air is assumed equal to outdoor air
assumptions.temperature_diurnal: sinusoid between monthly mean daily min and max, peak at 15:00 IST
assumptions.grain_aw: first-order exchange with the daily-mean shed RH (mean of the fitted cycle), scenario time constant tau
assumptions.probe: RH = 100 * a_w + noise + bias; temperature = grain temperature + noise + bias
